'''Sun Lance''' is the horse owned by [[Bukama Marenellin]] during the last days of the [[Aiel War]].

==Appearance==
Sun Lance is a yellow roan gelding.

==Activities==
Sun Lance carried Bukama from an area near [[Tar Valon]] to [[Canluum]].{{ref/book|0|1}}{{ref/book|0|15}} While staying at [[The Blue Rose]], Bukama checks on Sun Lance due to a bruised hoof.{{ref/book|0|16}} Because his hoof had not yet healed, Bukama was forced to traid Sun Lance for a new horse to leave Canluum.{{ref/book|0|17}} While riding his new black gelding, Bukama regrets leaving Sun Lance behind as the new horse is not nearly as well trained as Sun Lance was.{{ref/book|0|20}}
